title: NSA personnel attend Ramsay lecture

tellings.quote: We similarly had something like that happen in Baltimore too

plain: People from the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that listens in on communications, are said to have turned up at a public lecture in Baltimore, Maryland. Scott Ramsey, a researcher who studies a reported UFO crash said to have left alien bodies, tells Michels this happened at one of his own talks, saying "we similarly had something like that happen in Baltimore too." He gives it as a sign that intelligence agencies keep an eye on his work.
